name: E22 corroborated beaconing v3 (preregistration)
note: Written and committed BEFORE any v3 code exists or runs on data. Nothing is fitted to evaluation labels. Every constant below is fixed here; the only value computed later is tau_I, by the rule in 'signals.I', from dev benign data only, and it goes into a data-only amendment before any gate scoring. Any other change after a gate run needs a committed amendment with its reason and does not count for this gate. Human-readable copy: docs/plan-beaconing-detector.md section v3.
owner_target: Owner-set 2026-11-24: >= 30 % of botnet/C2 pairs caught at <= 1 % false-alert rate on at least two of {CTU-13, HIKARI, CIC-2018}, 95 % bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, seed 1337), AND a false-alert budget on fresh own-network data.

owner_decisions_2026_11_24.gate_data: fresh data only: CIC-2018 Bot day and CTU-13 set A (scenarios 1, 2, 3, 5 + the six CTU-Normal 2017 captures) are spent and are dev/regression rows only
owner_decisions_2026_11_24.own_network: owner records a new 72 h capture (task 14 in docs/human-benchmark-tasks.md)

unit: pair = (internal source host, destination key = SNI if the flow has one else destination IP), exactly as e21 v2a1. Host-level results (a host alerts if any of its pairs alerts) are reported next to every pair-level result.
eligibility: a pair is evaluated when it has >= 20 flows that START at or after the end of the learning window L; flows inside L still feed the scorer state. A labelled positive pair below 20 such flows, or absent, counts as a MISS (score 0), as e21 amendment 4.
verdict_time: the pair's state after the last flow of the evaluation stream (as e21 scripts: last verdict reached after L)

signals.B: beacon scorer v2a1 exactly as frozen in ci/prereg/e21.json (G, S, D, H; verdict needs G and D; unweighted mean); fires at score >= 0.8. Unchanged code.
signals.P: learned periodicity (E6-lite). During L, a destination key is learned as 'expected periodic' when ANY internal host's pair to it has >= 12 unique whole-second start times inside L and G (v2a1 formula, on those L-only start times) >= 0.8. At most 4096 learned keys (oldest learned dropped first). An entry expires 7 days after the end of L. While an entry is live, B is ignored for every pair with that destination key. No hand-written list.
signals.R: rare destination (E2.2). novel = the destination key was not seen from any internal host during L. prevalence = number of distinct internal hosts that contacted the key at or after L end. R fires when novel AND prevalence <= max(1, ceil(0.1 * H)), H = distinct internal hosts seen at or after L end. On single-host data prevalence cannot be measured; R then reduces to 'novel' and the report says so.
signals.F: rare fingerprint (E2.6, metadata only). fingerprint = JA4 of the client hello if present, else JA3. A fingerprint is novel when no internal host used it during L. F fires when the pair has >= 1 flow at or after L end with a novel fingerprint whose user count (distinct internal hosts at or after L end) <= max(1, ceil(0.1 * H)). Pairs without TLS cannot fire F.
signals.I: isolation-forest corroboration. I fires when the share of the pair's flows (at or after L end) flagged by the shipped detector's own threshold is >= tau_I. tau_I = the 0.99 quantile of that share over dev benign pairs (>= 20 flows) of CTU-Normal 2017-05-01 and 2017-05-02, with the detector trained (contamination 0.02, random_state 42) on CTU-Normal 2017-04-18, 04-19, 04-28, 04-30 (the section 10 split). Computed once by scripts/calibrate_e22.py and written into a data-only amendment before any gate run. No positive label is used.
signals.host_context_reported_not_used: per host per 1 h window: flow count, distinct destinations, distinct SNIs, new-destination rate; destination first-seen age. Computed and reported (E2.2) but NOT part of the fusion rule.

fusion.rule: pair alert = B AND NOT P AND (R OR F OR I). A beacon verdict alone never alerts. Fixed rule, no weights.
fusion.ranking_score_for_curves: fused = B score when (NOT P AND (R OR F OR I)) else 0; used only for ROC / recall-at-FPR reporting
fusion.flag: config corroboration_enabled, default OFF; beaconing_enabled stays OFF

learning_window_L.ctu13_fresh_and_ctu_normal_fresh: first 1 h of each capture (no earlier history of these networks exists); known consequence: C2 active from the first hour is not 'novel' and may be learned as periodic
learning_window_L.hikari: the 2021-04-11 and 2021-04-12 captures (the section 11 training slice) are L; later captures are evaluated
learning_window_L.sim_set_c: first 4 h of the run (no beacon starts before 4 h)

inside_networks.ctu13_fresh: default RFC1918 + fc00::/7 + 147.32.0.0/16 (the documented capture network, as e21 set A)
inside_networks.hikari: defaults (stated before seeing the data; attack pairs outside the internal->external scope are counted as misses, not dropped)

G1_ctu13_fresh.positives: CTU-13 scenarios 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 (Botnet-45, 47-54), public pcaps; pairs (inside 147.32.0.0/16 host -> other end) whose flows the dataset's own binetflow labels mark with 'CC' (e21 amendment 2 rule, text-only parsing)
G1_ctu13_fresh.negatives: every pair of CTU-Normal captures NOT in set A, selected by this rule before download: each CTU-Normal-N pcap on the Stratosphere dataset pages with N not in {20, 21, 23, 24, 26, 28} and size <= 1 GB; names and SHA-256 go into a data-only amendment before scoring
G1_ctu13_fresh.note: the public CTU-13 pcaps hold botnet-host traffic only; the botnet hosts' non-C2 pairs are reported outside the gate. Era mismatch (2011 botnet vs 2017 benign) remains.

G2_hikari.positives: pairs whose 4-tuple-labelled flows are majority attack (Bruteforce, Bruteforce-XML, XMRig), as the v1 protocol
G2_hikari.negatives: pairs with zero attack-labelled flows in the evaluated (post-L) captures
G2_hikari.known_consequence: the attack captures last about 150 s; v2a1 needs a 3 h span for a verdict, so B cannot fire on them and recall on HIKARI is expected to be about 0 BY CONSTRUCTION. Stated now so a zero is not read as a surprise. It still counts in the gate.

datasets.CIC2018: spent (dev row only); it cannot count towards the owner's 'two of three'

H1_sim_set_c.status: secondary preregistered hold-out (not part of the owner's gate); generated AFTER this file is committed; pcap hashes added by a data-only amendment
H1_sim_set_c.design: harmless simulator (backend/scripts/lab/beacon_sim, profile 'setc'), seed 2211, 16 h, 16 client hosts on the internal-only Docker network. Beacons: 16 cells (interval {10, 60, 300, 1800} s x jitter {0, 25, 50, 75} %), each cell on exactly 2 hosts (32 positive pairs; 24 gated at jitter <= 50 %), each beacon starting at U(4 h, 6 h). Benign: B1 browsing on shared SNIs all run; B1n: after 4 h each host browses 2 new SNIs of its own (novel and rare benign); B2 chat long-poll; B3 app polling windows anywhere in the run; B4 telemetry 300 s, B5 time-sync 64 s, B6 update check 3600 s on every host from t=0 (learnable); B7 a NEW periodic service (300 s +-10 %) starting at U(6 h, 8 h) on 3 hosts (novel, not rare); B8 a NEW periodic service (120 s +-10 %) starting at U(6 h, 8 h) on 1 host (novel AND rare AND periodic: the honest hard negative). All B classes are negatives in this set.
H1_sim_set_c.gate: fused recall >= 0.30 on the 24 gated beacon pairs with false-alert rate <= 1 % over all benign pairs (B1-B8, >= 20 post-L flows)

H2_own_network_2.status: human task 14; a NEW 72 h capture recorded after this file is committed
H2_own_network_2.budget: mean fused pair alerts per test day (days 2 and 3) <= 1.0 on the one laptop; the frozen v2a1 alone is reported beside it (it had 13-16 per day on the spent capture)

owner_gate_pass_if: fused binary recall >= 0.30 AND fused false-alert rate <= 0.01 (point estimates) on at least two of {G1 CTU-13 fresh, G2 HIKARI} (CIC-2018 is spent and cannot count)
gate.reported_with_every_number: 95 % bootstrap CI, 1000 resamples, seed 1337, pairs resampled within positives and within negatives (spectra.eval.metrics)
gate.on_failure: report 'ranking aid, not a detector' with the reason; corroboration_enabled and beaconing_enabled stay off; no retuning in this session
gate.not_run_rule: a set that cannot be obtained (download blocked, human task not done) is NOT RUN and the gate cannot pass
